role: Independent numerical implementation check after exact certificate and candidate freeze
ideal_logical_gate: diag(1,1,1,i) in order00,01,10,11; a common global phase is immaterial
reference_method: Reconstruct normalized4-by4-reference Choi state from16 normalized logical pure probes and compare with the ideal controlled-S Choi state
noise_cases: single-site coherent rotation with axis(1,2,3)/sqrt14 and anglepi/7
single-site amplitude damping gamma0,1/5,2/3,1 including both Kraus branches
noise_position: after transversal gate; before-gate controls if the frozen API exposes that ordering
recovery_contract: Accept unnormalized physical Kraus-branch vectors and return unnormalized4x4 logical density; sum branches without postselection or renormalization
negative_controls: all physical phase weights0 must fail exact CS certificate
lossy projection Vdagger without correction must fail for a singleX fault
logical dephasing must fail reference test despite correct basis-state outputs
wrong logical relative phase must fail
changed probability/missing mass must fail exact certificate
resource_method: No2^n-by2^n physical density matrix; pure branch vectors or sparse vectors are sufficient
interpretation: A finite numerical check of the frozen implementation supports its correctness on declared ideal error channels; exact KL supplies the algebraic guarantee. No physical device, noisy recovery circuit, threshold, preparation cost or business claim follows.
